basis.method: Qualitative watershed and hydrology framework derived only from existing schematic relief candidates; no DEM, numeric elevations, or hydrologic simulation.

candidate_divides.status: schematic ridge/divide trace only; exact watershed boundary unresolved
schematic ridge/divide trace only; arc endpoints and catchments unresolved
schematic ridge/divide trace only; valley outlets unresolved
schematic ridge/divide trace only; tectonic cause and catchments unresolved

potential_basin_zones.status: central basin inherited as candidate; closed versus open drainage unresolved
central basin candidate; endorheic versus exorheic drainage unresolved
interior basin candidate; connection to sea, enclosed bay, or lake unresolved

features.general_drainage_tendencies: Arrows indicate only broad downhill tendencies away from candidate highlands. They are not river centerlines, verified flow paths, or mapped outlets.

continent_status.The Central Reach: NW divide candidate; central basin remains unresolved; eastern plateau is lower relief candidate, not a proven drainage destination.
continent_status.The Verdant Wilds: NW-central arc used as a possible divide; no catchment boundaries or river courses assigned.
continent_status.The Frostbound Expanse: Central-northern highland used as a possible divide; no glacial drainage or fjord system inferred.
continent_status.The Ashen Frontier: Diagonal upland used as a possible divide; no volcanic or fault-controlled drainage inferred.
continent_status.The Sunken Sands: Central basin retained as an unresolved storage candidate; no desert, salt lake, or endorheic system inferred.
continent_status.The Veiled Continent: Interior basin retained as unresolved; no lake or enclosed-bay connection inferred.

limitations: All hydrology features are schematic candidates and remain NON-CANON.
V0.8 relief marks do not provide numeric elevations, ridge continuity, or slope gradients.
Candidate divide traces follow existing schematic mountain/highland symbols and are not validated watershed boundaries.
Arrows show broad conceptual drainage tendencies only; they are not river courses.
The Central Reach, Sunken Sands, and Veiled Continent basin candidates have unresolved outlet status.
No rivers, lakes, deltas, wetlands, glaciers, named waters, or settlements are assigned.
No story location is placed or repositioned.
The SVG uses an inherited linear coordinate scaffold, not a validated cartographic projection.
next_requirements: Establish relative elevation ordering and continuous ridge geometry.
Decide basin closure and outlet thresholds for each candidate basin.
Define catchment boundaries and check all flow paths against divides.
Only then draw river centerlines, tributaries, lakes, and outlets.
Validate coastline connectivity and any endorheic systems before assigning names.
